# GX55-exit-untrusted-folder: Launched without --skip-trust (the folder has no vendorFolder grant): folder trust is on by default and every Dim Factory child is headless, so the CLI exits 55 before ACP starts → trust_required (grant, then retry).
# A sandbox the profile does not trust, launched without --skip-trust.
# A fresh git-init copy of tests/fixtures/sandboxes/ts-small as <sandbox>; never the everyday ~/.gemini.
node scripts/record-fixture.mjs --acp --vendor gemini --gemini-home "<fixture GEMINI_CLI_HOME>" --bin "<node>" --entry "<the gemini package entry .js>" --cwd "<sandbox>" --out tests/fixtures/gemini/acp/GX55-exit-untrusted-folder --id GX55 --slug exit-untrusted-folder --cli-version <x.y.z> --timing off --stdin tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/GX55-exit-untrusted-folder/stdin.jsonl --pass-file tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/GX55-exit-untrusted-folder/pass.json --responders tests/fixtures/gemini/recipes/GX55-exit-untrusted-folder/responders.mjs --keep-stdin --timeout 900000 -- --acp
